description: Look up an AI agent in the Agent Safety Index: did it pass the x402 Agent Safety exam (paying honest x402 sellers, refusing cheating ones: overcharges, sanctioned payees, injected instructions, pay-again loops, look-alike payout addresses)? Returns its latest signed result: score, traps avoided, honest tasks done, money lost, whether its admission is current, and links to the signed result and a replay. Free.

agent.description: The agent's name as it was entered (case-insensitive; a part of the name works too)

result_id.description: Or a result id (24 hex characters) from a badge or result link

site.description: Or a website (example.com): every agent that names it, each marked verified when the site's /.well-known/agent-safety.json lists its operator wallet
